items.summary: RIYADH — Riyadh has ranked among the world’s top 100 innovation clusters in the 2026 Global Innovation Index, becoming the only Gulf city to achieve the classification. The Saudi capital ranked 92nd globally, recording 419 venture capital deals in innovation and 162 international patent applications. items.title: ‏استطلاع: الفيدرالي يثبت الفائدة حتى نهاية 2026
